callouts.label: Plan with a Trusted Adult
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents plan with a trusted adult.
callouts.description: Share where you will be, who is present, and how to get help.
callouts.tip: Agree on check-in and pickup options. A safety plan should allow asking for help without fear.

callouts.label: Charge the Phone
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents charge the phone.
callouts.description: A charged phone supports contact, navigation, and emergency calls.
callouts.tip: Bring a safe power option. Know important contacts beyond the device.

callouts.label: Use a Buddy Check-In
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents use a buddy check-in.
callouts.description: Friends can agree to check in and leave together.
callouts.tip: Do not make one peer solely responsible. Respect when someone wants to go.

callouts.label: Know the Exits
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents know the exits.
callouts.description: Notice safe exits, adult hosts, and calmer spaces.
callouts.tip: Leave early if the situation changes. Do not enter isolated or unsafe areas.

callouts.label: Keep Personal Items in Sight
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents keep personal items in sight.
callouts.description: Keep beverages, medication, and belongings under your control.
callouts.tip: Do not accept an opened item when you are uncertain. Ask an adult for help if tampering is suspected.

callouts.label: Refuse Pressure
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents refuse pressure.
callouts.description: Use a clear refusal, repeat it, change location, or involve support.
callouts.tip: You do not owe an explanation. Pressure is the responsibility of the person applying it.

callouts.label: Choose a Sober Ride
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents choose a sober ride.
callouts.description: Never ride with an impaired driver.
callouts.tip: Use a trusted adult, sober driver, transit, or safe place to stay. Plan more than one option.

callouts.label: Help a Sick Friend
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents help a sick friend.
callouts.description: Stay nearby when safe and involve an adult.
callouts.tip: Do not assume the person can sleep it off. Monitor breathing while emergency help is coming.

callouts.label: Call Emergency Help
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents call emergency help.
callouts.description: Unresponsiveness, breathing trouble, seizure, serious injury, or immediate danger require emergency services.
callouts.tip: Give the location and known facts. Do not delay because of fear of trouble.

callouts.label: Check In Afterward
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents check in afterward.
callouts.description: Confirm a safe return and talk about any concerning event.
callouts.tip: Preserve evidence when needed. Seek medical, counseling, or school support after harm.
